notes: v3.68.25: BCC thuyen vien = tab Tong hop thang (6 o so, bang theo tau, bang thuyen vien toan doi tau co loc) + tab tung tau (luoi ngay to mau theo ma, cot tong ma, muc di bien theo the, thanh tien trinh 5 buoc, loi ngay duoi luoi); In PDF / Excel BCC tong hop. BCC tu email / file = 'Tau da gui - cho kiem'; Tra ve tau = soan email tra loi tau (loi lay tu Kiem tra); tau gui lai sau khi tra ve -> lay so cua tau, liet ke o doi; hop thu: dong da ghi -> 'Da ghi - Mo BCC tau' + 'Ghi lai'.
